description: Read the shared Grandet application list and inference profiles before selecting a supplier. App profiles determine API compatibility; MCP capability alone does not prove an inference route or Skill installation. Use only when the target app ID, supported protocol or configuration variant is uncertain.

app.description: Catalogue app ID to show, e.g. "openclaw". Omit to list every app.

host.description: The assistant or app making this call, e.g. "claude-code" or "codex". Attribution only; it does not change results.

skillBuild.description: Grandet Skill build ID when called from the Skill. Omit otherwise.

skillVersion.description: Grandet Skill version when called from the Skill, e.g. "0.3.0". Omit otherwise.

targetApp.description: Catalogue ID of the app that will use the API, e.g. "openclaw", "claude-code" or "codex". Selects compatible protocols and connection steps. Send it only when the user says where the API will be used.

name: grandet_list_apps
title: Grandet application profiles / Grandet 应用接入清单
